description.en: An authored malachite-ore scenario with an assumed sulphidized floatability response. Reagent activation is not a modelled unit or chemistry; ten percent of the copper is assigned to poorly floating chrysocolla.
description.es: Escenario de autor de un mineral de malaquita con una respuesta de flotabilidad sulfidizada supuesta. La activación del reactivo no es una unidad ni una química modelada; diez por ciento del cobre se asigna a crisocola de baja flotabilidad.

question.en: How does poorly floating chrysocolla constrain the assumed oxide-copper response?
question.es: ¿Cómo limita la crisocola de baja flotabilidad la respuesta supuesta del cobre oxidado?

provenance: authored scenario; parameters inside cited ranges; not plant-calibrated

sources.breakage: Moly-Cop Tools energy-specific selection (alpha0 0.0091 t/kWh, alpha1 0.651, alpha2 2.5, d_crit 6514 µm) and its documented alternative breakage set (beta0 0.4, beta1 0.65, beta2 4.02); methodology page 03.
sources.crusher: Whiten classification K1 0.5 to 0.95 CSS, K2 1.7 to 3.5 CSS, K3 about 2.3; methodology page 02.
sources.cyclone: Plitt geometry ratios typical of mineral-processing cyclones; sharpness and underflow density authored; methodology page 04.
sources.flotation: k from bubble surface area flux (Gorain et al. 1997), Savassi entrainment, perfect-mixer banks; floatability and widths authored within Trahar (1981) size behaviour; methodology page 05.
sources.collector: Saturating collector response with gangue saturating at a higher dose, an authored form whose direction the chalcopyrite/pyrite review supports (Castellón et al. 2022, Materials 15(19):6536, doi:10.3390/ma15196536); methodology page 05.
sources.water: Process-water capacity per tonne of ore (pumping and thickener capacity), authored 5% above each case's nominal requirement; it is the water constraint of the operating-point optimizer.
sources.kpi: Each nominal KPI range carries its own source in kpi_sources: a published value or range where one was found, labelled authored where none was; they are plausibility gates, not predictions.

recovery_pct.en: Authored range for this assumed mineral-response case. The cited 2022 malachite sulphidisation-xanthate results are context only; reagent activation is not simulated.
recovery_pct.es: Rango de autor para este caso de respuesta mineral supuesta. Los resultados citados de 2022 sobre malaquita con sulfidización y xantato son solo contexto; la activación del reactivo no se simula.

concentrate_grade.en: Authored range for this assumed mineral-response case. The cited sulphidisation-xanthate grades are not a validation target because reagent chemistry is outside the model.
concentrate_grade.es: Rango de autor para este caso de respuesta mineral supuesta. Las leyes citadas de sulfidización-xantato no validan el modelo porque la química del reactivo queda fuera de su alcance.
